fact: The Nafa cash transfer programme, part of the World Bank and Gambia Government funded RISE project run by the National Nutrition Agency, pays bi-monthly D3000 transfers to beneficiary households, now cashlessly through the Wave fintech solution, according to NaNA's accountant and a community development officer.

The Standard reports that the Nafa cash transfer, run by the National Nutrition Agency with the Department of Community Development and the Directorate of Social Welfare under the World Bank-funded RISE Project, was paid electronically through QMoney's platform, provincial beneficiaries receiving their fifth round and Banjul, KMC and parts of Kombo their first.
